{{Top|canon=Mini-reactor}}
A '''minireactor''' was a compact power source used by [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]]. As the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was equipped with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], the minireactor was required to counter the significant power drain that these systems created.<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
